name: Clonazepam
toxicity: potentially lethal when mixed with depressants like alcohol or opioids
summary: A medium-length common prescription benzodiazepine, often used to treat panic attacks because of its relatively fast sublingual onset. Primarily anxiolytic, but also possessing of other benzodiazepine traits.
doseBasis: NOTE: 0.5mg of Clonazepam is approximately equal to 10mg Diazepam.

pharmacology.text: Clonazepam enhances the activity of the inhibitory neurotransmitter gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) in the central nervous system to give its anticonvulsant, skeletal muscle relaxant, and anxiolytic effects. It acts by binding to the benzodiazepine site of the GABA receptors, which enhances the electric effect of GABA binding on neurons, resulting in an increased influx of chloride ions into the neurons.

uses.text: Clonazepam, sold under the brand name Klonopin among others, is a benzodiazepine medication used to prevent and treat anxiety disorders, seizures, and akathisia, with some evidence supporting use in treatment of mania due to bipolar disorder. It is typically taken orally (swallowed by mouth) but is also used intravenously. Clonazepam was patented in 1960 and approved in 1975 in the United States from Roche.
uses.recreational: A 2006 US government study of hospital emergency department visits found that sedative-hypnotics were the most frequently implicated pharmaceutical drug in visits, with benzodiazepines accounting for the majority of these. Clonazepam was the second most frequently implicated benzodiazepine. Alcohol alone was responsible for over twice as many visits as clonazepam in the same study.

sideEffects.text: Short-term side effects can include sleepiness, weakness, poor coordination, difficulty concentrating, agitation, and impared memory formation.

summaryZh: 氯硝西泮，常見商品名「Klonopin」、「利福全」、「利平靜」，為一種苯二氮䓬類鎮定劑，常用於治療及預防癲癇發作、恐慌症，以及靜坐不能。本品可以口服，藥物會在服藥後1小時內作用，效果可維持6至12小時。

fact.en: Clonazepam carries a nitro group, like nitrazepam and flunitrazepam. The body turns this group into an amine, giving 7-aminoclonazepam, the substance many drug tests look for.
fact.zh: 氯硝西泮和硝西泮、氟硝西泮一樣帶有硝基。身體會把硝基轉化成胺基，形成 7-胺基氯硝西泮，許多藥物檢測要找的就是這個物質。
fact.zhHans: 氯硝西泮和硝西泮、氟硝西泮一样带有硝基。身体会把硝基转化成胺基，形成 7-胺基氯硝西泮，许多药物检测要找的就是这个物质。
